posts.author: Piyan Glupak
posts.body:
There are several plugins that let you add entries to the main menu. I am not familiar with the VisuStela one, but they nearly all work by letting you call a common event from the new menu entry. You could have a series of "Show Text" editor commands in the common event, but another way would be to use the "Show Picture" editor command. (You would have to prepare the picture yourself, using something like GIMP or Photoshop.)
If you did decide to use a series of "Show Text" messages, remember that you can use the code "\I[n]" (where 'n' is a number), to show whichever icon is number 'n'.
Edit
: This is for Yanfly's Main Menu Manager (which does work on MZ), but the plugin parameters might be similar for VisuStela:
The '16' is the number of the common event for it to call. Note that because I want the Credits to be accessible anytime during the game "Show" and "Enabled" are both true.
